fusions.name: Braided Lash
fusions.desc: Swings a braided, weighted cord that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Anything struck moves 25% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Pillars Pulled Down
fusions.desc: Brings down everything around you, dealing 36 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Matted Padding
fusions.desc: Beats loose strands into felt around you, which absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Uncut Locks

riders.text: every blow lands with more behind it
and you carry more before you break
and the heaviest blows land heavier still

fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1.
